newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI, Universal in property deal.
newsitem.headline: DMCI, Universal in property deal.

text.p: DMCI Holdings Inc said on Monday its wholly-owned unit, DMCI Project Developers Inc, signed a memorandum of understanding with Universal Rightfield Property Holdings Inc and the Yulo family to develop a 100-hectare project south of Manila.

In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, DMCI said the joint venture on the Villas Del Sol project will cost 2.4 billion pesos for the development of a 60-hectare property in Canlubang, Laguna.
In the future, another 40 hectares will be developed into a mixed-use residential, commercial and industrial property.
The Yulo family, which will contribute the land, would have a 65 percent stake in the project; DMCI Project Developers, 25 percent; and Universal Rightfield, 10 percent.
The joint venture will have an authorized capital of 1.0 billion pesos.
